parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Part one.

You will hear a woman phoning a furniture company to inquire about ordering a bed.

First, you have some time to look at questions one to six.

Now listen carefully and answer questions one to six.

ECL Furnishings, Anthony speaking. How can I help you?

Oh, I was looking at your internet site, and I'm interested in ordering a bed.

Certainly, madam. What sort of thing did you have in mind?

Well, I saw one I liked, but I can't remember the name of the design.

Well, we have three basic models. There's the Classic, the Oxford, and the London.

Yes, I remember now. I was looking at the Classic and the Oxford. They look nearly the same.

Yes. Well, the Classic has a higher headboard, which some people like.

Uh-huh.

Whereas the Oxford has a lower one.

Hmm. Well, actually, it's not a big room, so I'll go for that one.

Right. Yes, that's very popular. Now, what size did you want?

Well, nothing too high, as far as the base goes, I mean.

The standard height's thirty centimeters. That's the same for all our beds, but we can offer various alternatives for width and length.

I want around four foot six inches wide.

It's all centimeters now, so you'll be wanting one hundred and forty centimeters. What about the length?

Well, that's why I was interested, actually, because I saw you have a range there. You see, Roger, my son, the bed's for him, and he's very tall, six foot four. So I was interested in the longer length.

Yes, we can do any length for you. Two hundred and twenty centimeters sounds about right in this case. The standard is two hundred, but that extra twenty centimeters would just give him that bit of extra room.

Fine.

Now, we do offer this bed in three wood finishes. That's dark, natural, or bleached finish.

Hmm.

It depends really on the rest of the furniture in the room.

Well, that's all quite dark, but actually, I think I'll go for the natural. The room could do with lightening up a bit.

Right. So for this, uh, let's see, a standard for that width would be two hundred and twenty-five pounds, and with the extra length, we're looking at two hundred and sixty-five pounds.

Does that include delivery?

Yes, but the bed will be delivered flat-packed, so there's an extra twenty-five pounds if you want assembly. Well, which would bring it to two hundred and ninety pounds.

No, flat-packed is fine. My son can do the assembly.

Okay, fine. Now, we do have a special offer on this month for bedside tables in that range. I don't know if you're interested?

Well, he could certainly do with one. How much are they?

They're a very good value. They're sixty-four pounds ninety-nine individually, or a pair for one hundred and fifteen pounds. That's flat-packed again.

I just want the one. That sounds very reasonable.

And then there are various options which you can have at no extra cost. So, for example, you can have an in-go light, which is very useful for reading.

Oh, yes, I'll have that. Very nice. And does it have a cupboard?

Yes, and you have a choice of a wooden door or a glass one.

Right. I think Roger would like the glass one.

Okay. And that comes with two adjustable shelves in the cupboard. And you also have a choice of one more open shelf above the cupboard, or a drawer on top.

Does the drawer have a lock?

Let me check. Yes, it does.

Right. That will be best then. I'll go for that.

Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions seven to ten.

Now listen and answer questions seven to ten.

Okay, so now I just need to take a few details for delivery. So if I could just have your name, please.

Mrs. S. Rogala, R-O-G-A-L-A. And the address is Bell Hill Farm.

Uh, that's Bell Hill, two words?

Uh-huh. Farm. That's in Shifton.

Shifton. Oh, yes, I know. Oh, it's a nice village, isn't it? Now, are you right in center?

No, the farm's a couple of miles south, but anyone can direct you at the village. Oh, and the postcode's HE25 4EU.

Thanks. And do you have a contact phone number?

Mm, oh one two six seven five two three four nine nine. So when do you think I'll get it?

We should get it to you by next week. Will someone be in, or is there somewhere we could leave it? Or a neighbor?

Well, I'm usually in in the morning, so that's the best time. I tend to be out in the afternoon. And the nearest neighbors are in the village, but just leave it in the garage if no one's in. It'll be quite safe there. It's just behind the house.

That's fine. So the last thing is payment.

That is the end of part one. You now have one minute to check your answers to part one.

analyses.content: 男客服将女顾客说的英制宽度换算成了公制单位，明确提到需要140厘米（one hundred and forty centimeters）。
你可能会听到前面的数字“four”或“six”，但这里问的是以厘米（cm）为单位的宽度，要留意单位转换后的数字。
I want around four foot six inches wide. It's all centimeters now, so you'll be wanting one hundred and forty centimeters.
女顾客在听完三种木材颜色选项后，明确表示自己想要自然色（natural）来让房间感觉亮一点。
你可能会因为前面提到了dark或bleached而填错，一定要听到最后顾客最终拍板的决定。

Now, we do offer this bed in three wood finishes. That's dark, natural, or bleached finish. Hmm. It depends really on the rest of the furniture in the room. Well, that's all quite dark, but actually, I think I'll go for the natural. The room could do with lightening up a bit.
加长版床的价格是265英镑且包含配送，顾客之后拒绝了需要额外收费的组装服务，因此总费用依然是265。
你可能会把组装后的总价290或标准版价格225填进去，要注意区分各项费用并留意顾客到底选了哪种服务。

So for this, uh, let's see, a standard for that width would be two hundred and twenty-five pounds, and with the extra length, we're looking at two hundred and sixty-five pounds. Does that include delivery? Yes, but the bed will be delivered flat-packed, so there's an extra twenty-five pounds if you want assembly. Well, which would bring it to two hundred and ninety pounds. No, flat-packed is fine. My son can do the assembly.
男客服推荐了一款对阅读很有用的嵌入式灯（light），女顾客紧接着确认要这个免费配件。
听到“reading”时要立刻捕捉它前面的关键物品，也就是可以用来阅读的“light”。
And then there are various options which you can have at no extra cost. So, for example, you can have an in-go light, which is very useful for reading. Oh, yes, I'll have that.
客服提供木门或玻璃门的选择后，女顾客明确表示儿子会喜欢玻璃（glass）门。
听到干扰词wooden不要急着写，要听完整个句子，捕捉到最终被选定的材质才是正确答案。
And does it have a cupboard? Yes, and you have a choice of a wooden door or a glass one. Right. I think Roger would like the glass one.
顾客专门确认了抽屉（drawer）是否带锁，得到肯定答复后便拍板选了它。
这道题的强干扰项是shelf，但因为题目条件限制了必须带锁（locked），所以只能选被确认有锁的drawer。

And that comes with two adjustable shelves in the cupboard. And you also have a choice of one more open shelf above the cupboard, or a drawer on top. Does the drawer have a lock? Let me check. Yes, it does. Right. That will be best then. I'll go for that.
客服询问名字后，顾客给出了自己的姓氏Rogala并进行了逐个字母拼写（R-O-G-A-L-A）。
这类人名拼写题一定要紧跟字母发音，不要因为没听过这个陌生的名字就慌张，按着她念的字母原样写下即可。
So if I could just have your name, please. Mrs. S. Rogala, R-O-G-A-L-A.
顾客在报完地址后，直接且清晰地念出了邮政编码HE25 4EU。
数字和字母混杂时非常容易漏听或写错，尤其要注意不要把发音相近的字母“E”和“U”听混了。
Oh, and the postcode's HE25 4EU.
客服询问下周配送什么时候方便，顾客回答说早上（morning）通常在家，是最佳收货时间。
顾客后面紧接着说下午会出门（out in the afternoon），注意别把表示不在家的干扰时间段填进去。

We should get it to you by next week. Will someone be in, or is there somewhere we could leave it? Or a neighbor? Well, I'm usually in in the morning, so that's the best time. I tend to be out in the afternoon.
顾客明确交代，如果没人在家（if no one's in），就把货物留在车库（garage）里。
你可能会听到neighbor或者village，但这只是铺垫，真正的放置地点是由“leave it in”后面的词决定的。
And the nearest neighbors are in the village, but just leave it in the garage if no one's in. It'll be quite safe there. It's just behind the house.
